correctness.rationale: For all n>=4, proof classifies every maximal intersecting pair family as one star or triangle; every 3-clique membership pattern has an explicit witness. Disjoint edges and >=4-edge stars fail specified patterns. Edge count gives all face coefficients. The first-positive-branch size-two obstruction proves Ldim<=3 while a fixed shattered triple proves >=3. Star 2-skeleta and triangle attachments prove pi1=0 and Euler rank B_n; H2 is integral free. Two independent finite codebases test every support through size four at n=4..8 and a boundary checker recovers Betti ranks. Computation only corroborates the all-order proof.

value.rationale: Provides a complete natural learning-theoretic classification of maximal intersecting two-subset families (equivalently maximal independent sets of KG(n,2)), with an exact all-order polynomial, static and adaptive ranks and integral homotopy type. Although both ranks remain 3 and the full parent complex has binom(n-1,3) spheres, its shattering skeleton carries the additional n*binom(n-2,3) independent two-sphere classes. The rank comparison is a structurally motivated truncation effect and gives information not contained in known full-complex topology; it is not a single-size calculation.
